correctness.rationale: For every q≥2 and n≥1, deleting original-input first symbols of all noninitial runs removes exactly s−1 symbols where s=#input runs; deletion cannot increase runs, so any output y satisfies |y|+r(y)−1≤n. Conversely appending one new leading symbol to each noninitial run of y constructs a minimal preimage and padding by n−|y|−r(y)+1 new singleton runs (alternating letters, always possible for q=2) constructs every larger source length. Run-composition counting proves exact N_{n,m}, summing minimal feasible lengths gives qt z/((1−z)(1−tz−(q−1)tz²)); deterministic fiber representatives prove exact zero-error code size. Unique dominant pole near t=1 yields capacity and quasi-power characteristic function with μ=(1+1/√(4q−3))/2 and σ²=(q−1)/(4q−3)^(3/2)>0. New independent exhaustive image computation across 23 (q,n) pairs totaling 10785 input words and symbolic derivative identities checked; infinite CLT rests on analytic proof.

value.rationale: Threshold-one is a natural exact endpoint and benchmark for context-dependent deletion channels, giving not just capacity but every finite-block output frequency and a genuine Gaussian law for lengths of uniformly chosen distinct outputs. It clarifies the distinction between uniform source inputs and uniform distinct outputs and supports exact zero-error representative codes. The structural image criterion is independently useful.
